build_train_args_parser: build an argparse parser with base, data, model, diffusion, and training options for motion diffusion model training
build_sample_args_parser: build an argparse parser with base and sampling options that loads model args from a checkpoint file
build_evaluation_args_parser: build an argparse parser with base and evaluation options that loads model args from a checkpoint file
create_add_model_options: create argument group options for model architecture including layers, latent dimension, and motion feature dimensions
create_add_diffusion_options: create argument group options for diffusion process including noise schedule, diffusion steps, and sigma values
